caption: The drawing features six distinct objects, each illustrated with detailed line work and labeled accordingly. At the top left is a hinge depicted in black and white with a textured pattern indicating material detail. Centered at the top is a handle, shown in a brown color, with a decorative, elaborate design including a cross-like shape at the uppermost point and several cut-out diamond and oval shapes, as well as visible fasteners. To the top right is a bell cord guide, drawn in black and white in two views: a side view and a bottom view, with a cord hanging from it. At the bottom left is the upper hasp, illustrated in black and white, showing a long, vertically-oriented piece with a curved end, rectangular fastening plates, and a latch mechanism, accompanied by a side view of the same object. On the bottom right is the lower hasp, similarly depicted in black and white with a hook-shaped latch and securing plates, shown both from the front and from the side. All objects are labeled beneath the drawings, and each drawing features a horizontal scale bar for measurements. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or light tan color.
title: Doorway and Doors
